stories.h: Coastal flood advisory for Pierce shorelines today
stories.s: An NWS advisory runs 2 a.m.–5 p.m. Tuesday for Pierce lowlands, with 1.5–2.5 ft of inundation possible at high tide. Watches follow for Wednesday and Thursday.

stories.h: Puyallup officer shoots man in overnight incident
stories.s: A Puyallup officer shot a man around 3:30 a.m. Tuesday on 8th Ave. NW; he is expected to recover and no officers were hurt. Pierce County deputies are investigating.

stories.h: Two years for attempted kidnapping of Lakewood barista
stories.s: A Kent man was sentenced for trying to pull a Lakewood drive-thru barista through the window in August 2025. He must register as a sex offender and stay away from drive-thru coffee stands.

coming.h: King tide flood watch continues through Thursday
coming.s: NWS flood watches for Pierce lowlands run late Tuesday night through Wednesday afternoon (2–3 ft) and Wednesday night through Thursday afternoon (2.5–3.5 ft).
